title: DuckDB connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One DuckDB instance's settings, read by the ADBC module (`loams_connector_analytics::adbc`, CN2 Task 17, R17.7) under the target profile `duckdb`, whose defaults set `driver: duckdb`. The driver is loaded by path from the runtime's allowlist (`LOAMS_ADBC_ALLOWLIST`) with a SHA-256 check (CN1 Ruling 9); the instance only names it.

driver.description: An allowlisted ADBC driver's name; the `duckdb` profile defaults it.

database.description: Database options passed to the driver as strings: `path` is DuckDB's database file. Never a secret.

query.description: The source's query, streamed as Arrow batches. Give it an `ORDER BY` for an exact resume (R17.9).

sink.description: The sink: ADBC bulk ingest per batch.

mode.description: `append`, or `create_append` to create the table from the first batch when it does not exist.
